description: Follow-up to audit_log_infrastructure_20260603. Add a 7-year FERPA retention policy with a periodic cleanup job over audit_events (and other PII-bearing tables, scoped to audit_events here), and a GDPR/FERPA DSAR (Data Subject Access Request) bulk-export endpoint that gathers all audit + profile data for a given subject into a downloadable archive. ADMIN-only, tenant-scoped. Builds on the append-only audit_events table and recordAuditEvent helper.
notes: Registry previously listed this as 'Audit Log Retention + DSAR Bulk Export' under Pending Tracks with no track dir. This track materializes spec+plan. Real-time audit-event streaming (the original 'depends on Observability') is descoped to a soft dependency: retention + batch DSAR export do not require streaming.
